C-43.Name: Diff against Mark's own snapshots: ⌘D shows what the agent changed with its last save
C-43.Summary: ⌘D (M-031 diff view) needs a baseline: a `<file>.before` sidecar that nothing creates, or git HEAD, which the App Store build cannot run. So for most users ⌘D says the diff is unavailable. Mark already sees every external save (live reload, store/editor.js APPLY_FILE_CHANGE → loadChange); keep the content the tab had just before each external reload as an in-memory snapshot and diff against it.

Problem.Description: User 2026-10-15 asked whether the storyboard's ⌘D scene works; it only works with a .before file or git (desktop build). User approved C-43, simple variant: «да, делаем C-43, начни с простого варианта».

Goals.R-1: On every external change that live reload applies to a tab (data path and disk-read path, and the confirm path of a dirty-tab conflict), store the tab's markdown from before the reload as a snapshot { markdown, takenAt } in an in-memory ring per tab (last 5), only when the content actually differs.
Goals.R-2: Baseline priority for ⌘D: the latest Mark snapshot of this tab → `<file>.before` → git HEAD (desktop build only), via the existing mt_diff_baseline for the last two.
Goals.R-3: Diff header names the source in plain words: "Before the last external save · 10:42:07" / ".before file" / "Last commit"; strings in all locales.
Goals.R-4: Snapshots live only while the tab is open (dropped on close; follow the tab through a sidebar rename; untitled tabs never get snapshots). No disk writes, no new IPC permissions — works in the App Store sandbox.

S1.Title: Snapshot ring + baseline priority + header label

S2.Title: Later: step back through older snapshots; persist across launches (needs a decision)

C-43.Dependencies: M-031 diff view; live reload (C-2). Base for C-26 (comments / accept-revert on agent edits).

Constraints.Constraint: No disk writes and no new IPC permissions; memory bounded (5 snapshots per tab).
The user's own edits never create snapshots; only external changes applied by live reload do.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Inline diff on the rendered page; accept/revert per hunk (C-26).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Open a file, an external process rewrites it, Mark reloads; ⌘D shows the change with the header "Before the last external save · time" — in a build without git and without a .before file.

AffectedAreas.M-011: store/editor.js live reload, diffView.vue, editorWithTabs diff entry, locales

C-43.VerificationIntent: Unit tests for the ring (capture on external change only, dedupe, cap 5, drop on close, follow rename) and the baseline priority; e2e: external change via the shim → ⌘D shows the diff with the snapshot header.
